Status
: [In production]{.proto-status .s-prod}

What it is
: An application that prepares non-clinical image files and metadata for BigPicture. It removes sensitive information, converts the metadata to the [metadata standard](metadata-standard.qmd), and uploads.

Who it's for
: Non-clinical data contributors, through the non-clinical node.

Provided by
: Deciphex. Installed at your site.

Before you start

: Contact the Service Desk. Deciphex installs the Data transporter for you and writes the metadata scripts your data needs.

Contributing non-clinical data? The Data transporter cleans your image files of sensitive information, converts the metadata to the BigPicture standard, and uploads it.

You don't install it yourself. Ask the Service Desk, and Deciphex sets it up at your site with scripts made for your data. Clinical data goes through [SlideTap](slidetap.qmd) instead.
